cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：一部分
cards.example_en: I saved a portion of the pizza for my brother.
cards.example_zh: 我留了一部分披萨给弟弟。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: You need a teaching qualification for this job.
cards.example_zh: 您需要获得此工作的教学资格。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: I prefer the film version of that famous story.
cards.example_zh: 我更喜欢那个著名故事的电影版本。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：获得；习得
cards.example_zh: 儿童很快就学会了语言。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：做广告
cards.example_en: Shops advertise summer clothes in the window this week.
cards.example_zh: 各家商店本周在橱窗里为夏装做广告。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：建议；劝告
cards.example_en: Doctors advise children to sleep eight hours a night.
cards.example_zh: 医生建议孩子们每晚睡八个小时。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：害怕的
cards.example_en: My little brother is afraid of the dark.

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Teachers allocate seats before the written exam begins.
cards.example_zh: 笔试开始之前，老师们分配座位。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：生气的
cards.example_en: Dad was angry because I broke the window.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸很生气，因为我打破了窗户。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: That antique clock still rings in my grandfather's house.
cards.example_zh: 那座古董钟在我爷爷家里还会响。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: A bee attack sent the campers running indoors.
cards.example_zh: 蜜蜂突然袭击，露营的人全跑进了屋里。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: She has a positive attitude to life.

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Bright colors attract bees to the flowers by the wall.
cards.example_zh: 鲜艳的颜色把蜜蜂吸引到墙边的花上。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：阿姨；姑姑
cards.example_en: My aunt brought dumplings when she visited on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 姑姑星期天来看我们时，带来了饺子。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Good behaviour on the bus keeps everyone safe.
cards.example_zh: 公交车上的良好行为能保障每个人的安全。
